title: Tropical storm Marie moves across Pacific, tracking path
seoTitle: Tropical storm Marie moves across Pacific, tracking path
subtitle: System could become a hurricane and bring rain and high waves for the holiday
excerpt: Tropical storm Marie draws attention as it moves across the Pacific with the potential to become a hurricane and affect the U.S. coast.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: ABC7 Los Angeles, NBC Los Angeles
contentHtml:
Tropical storm Marie is being monitored in the Pacific Ocean and could turn into a hurricane, bringing risks of rain and high waves to the coast. The storm's advance is generating anticipation and activity in coastal communities preparing for weekend impacts.

Monitoring of tropical storm Marie

The system is moving northward and there is a possibility that the storm will strengthen and become a hurricane. With the warm El Niño waters, several tropical systems are forming in the Pacific Ocean and influencing weather conditions.

Forecast of rain and high waves

If the storm approaches the shore, the scenario may include rain, strong winds, and high waves. The National Weather Service indicated the probability of large waves and strong back‑flow currents, as well as a moderate chance of coastal flooding on south‑facing beaches.

Use of forecast models

Computers perform billions of calculations to generate graphics known as spaghetti models, which help understand the possible trajectory of the storm. Grouped lines indicate higher confidence in the forecast, while separated lines show uncertainty about the exact path of the system.

Preparations in coastal communities

Residents and work crews are taking preventive actions in shoreline areas, such as building sand barriers to protect homes and businesses. People living on the Long Beach peninsula deal with frequent coastal flooding events and are closely monitoring the situation.

Guidelines for beaches and swimmers

Lifeguards warn about the expected large crowds on the beaches and recommend caution with individual limitations in the water. Talking to rescue professionals is highlighted as an essential measure to ensure safety during the celebration period.

With information from ABC7 Los Angeles, NBC Los Angeles.
